/s/.context: After voiceless consonants other than sibilants (/p, t, k, f, theta/)

/z/.context: After voiced sounds other than sibilants (/b, d, ɡ, v, ð, m, n, ŋ, l, r/ and vowels)

/ɪz/ or /əz/.context: After sibilants (/s, z, ʃ, ʒ, tʃ, dʒ/)

/t/.context: After voiceless consonants other than /t/ (/p, k, f, theta, s, ʃ, tʃ/)

/d/.context: After voiced sounds other than /d/ (/b, ɡ, v, ð, z, ʒ, dʒ, m, n, ŋ, l, r/ and vowels)
